data.one_liner: Read text content and metadata from PDF documents on iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to read text contents from PDF documents using files, paths, or URLs. It supports password-encrypted PDFs, extracts document info like authors and creation dates, and handles page-level lazy loading and caching.
use_when: You need to extract text from local or remote PDF files in a Flutter app.
You need to read metadata (author, title, creation date) from a PDF.
avoid_when: You need to generate or render visual pages of a PDF as images or views.
You need to edit or create new PDF documents.
strengths: Supports loading from files, paths, and URLs.
Applies lazy loading and caching for page text performance.
weaknesses: Limited to text extraction and document info retrieval (no rendering or editing).
data.setup_notes: Works out of the box on iOS and Android using native PDFKit and PdfBox-Android respectively.
